metadata.scope: Four public Briefcase-Lite business scenario tasks, six recorded models each; only four complete reference vectors enter each joint fit.

task_and_uuid_manifest.used_for: Self-contained task metadata and exact UUID mapping; no legacy nine-dimensional scores or caveats

metadata.excluded_models_policy: Keep Opus 4 and o3 observations but exclude them from joint four-dimensional fitting due to missing capability categories.

evidence.source_policy: Exact UUID binding to user-approved reference records. Require all four model categories; preserve missing records as excluded observations without imputation.

calibration_method.objective: mean((observed_normalized_score - bias - X beta)**2) + ridge * sum(beta**2), beta >= 0
calibration_method.weight_derivation: weights = beta / sum(beta); scale = sum(beta); bias is separate
calibration_method.algorithm_origin: GeneralRouter engineering choice, not an AA task annotation or official AA calibration algorithm.
calibration_method.missing_data_policy: Exclude an observation when any of its four capability values is null; do not impute or switch to a single-dimension fit.
calibration_method.normalization_scope: Use the fixed [0, 1] AA component-derived category scores in the snapshot; do not apply model-pool minmax.

rules: Numerical references require status regularized_reference_fit and fit_kind joint_four_dimension_reference.
Retain anchor ids and snapshot model hash for an analogous-task estimate.
Only close analogues of the four Briefcase-Lite business deliverables are covered. General coding, factual Q&A, long-document reasoning, and science problems remain unsupported.
An analogous task receives a planner estimate, not a newly measured or directly calibrated task vector.
Fitted weights are not semantic work percentages; score proxies are not calibrated probability or difficulty.

limitations: Four complete reference models per task are fewer than four coefficients plus an intercept; regularization selects a reference solution, not a uniquely identified task vector.
The 16 included observations cover four outputs within one shared business scenario; the eight incomplete-model observations are retained but excluded.
Reference capabilities and public task-score runtime conditions are not independently verified as identical; user confirmations and undisclosed effort are recorded separately.
The model-side knowledge_document category still includes GDP.pdf aggregate scores. Only GDP.pdf task examples were excluded at the user's request.
No testing, review, predictive validation, or model invocations were performed.
